name: mirofish
description: MiroFish - 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:backend:venv: cd backend && python3.11 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.setup:all:venv: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend:venv
scripts.dev:copilot: concurrently --kill-others -n "adapter,backend,frontend" -c "magenta,green,cyan" "npm run copilot-adapter" "npm run backend:venv" "npm run frontend"
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
